signals.evidence: voice_webhooks.rs:535 — oauth_token_refresh handler signature has NO AuthUser extractor (contrast sibling oauth_token_exchange). Mounted at /api/v1/webhooks/voice/oauth/refresh via routes/mod.rs:126. VoiceTokenRefreshRequest = {device_id: Uuid} only. Downstream call oauth_manager.refresh_token(...) rotates access_token_encrypted + access_token_hash on the device row. Any caller with a device_id can DoS the integration and amplify traffic to Amazon/Google. Reachability confirmed: pub mod voice_webhooks + .route('/oauth/refresh', post(oauth_token_refresh)).

voice_webhooks.rs:1087 — verify_google_request returns Ok(()) for: no project-id configured, missing Auth header, JWT-payload-contains-substring match, AND base64-decode failure. Doc comment above function explicitly acknowledges the missing JWKS+signature+iss+aud+exp steps. STANDARD base64 alphabet used to decode URL-safe unpadded JWT payloads → real Google JWTs mis-decode → still fall through to Ok(()). Only real gate on POST /google is authenticate_voice_user's OAuth access-token check. Sibling verify_hmac_signature (PR #2748) already demonstrates the fail-closed pattern.

voice_webhooks.rs:886 — reqwest::Client::new().get(url).send() with no builder timeout/connect_timeout, and client not memoised across calls. Under S3 slow-loris or cold-cache burst, holds Axum tasks + a DB RlsConnection (acquired above in alexa_webhook) for reqwest's default read window.
